request.what: Fund Tweag by Modus Create to deliver 3 interdependent work packages of core infrastructure, centred on mainnet deployment of Peras (faster finality), plus History Expiry and conformance testing
deliverables: Peras v1 production cryptography, KillSwitch and mainnet readiness

claims.claim: Peras v1 (faster finality, ~2 min vs ~12 min) remains undeployed on mainnet and requires production cryptography and hard-fork readiness
The 3 work packages are interdependent and should be funded as a single delivery pipeline, not a modular menu
The 18,263,496 ADA ask is based on $176/hour senior-engineer rates and a conservative 0.25 ADA/USD conversion
Peras and Leios are required to unlock higher transaction volume, staking rewards and TVL

summary: An 18.26M ADA request for Tweag to deliver Peras mainnet finality plus History Expiry and conformance testing over 2026-2027, priced off senior-engineer hourly rates.
